summary: Defines OSPFv2 extensions for Bit Index Explicit Replication, an architecture for multicast forwarding that needs no per-flow state in intermediate routers and no explicit tree-building protocol. The extensions let routers advertise the information BIER needs.

eli5.summary: Instead of each helper remembering who gets a copy of a message, the sender stamps the list of recipients on it, and routers just follow the stamp.

questions: how does ospfv2 advertise bier information
